newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Coelce started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coelce started as buy.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais has initiated coverage of Brazil's Cia Energetica do Ceara (Coelce) by assigning a buy rating to shares of the electric utility, which owned by the northeastern state of Ceara.
-- Analyst Rosana Aldworth said the recommendation reflected the planned privatization of the company in the first half of 1998 and Coelce's improved operating efficiency since 1996.
-- "Continued improvement is expected in overall operating efficiency," she said.

-- Energy consumption in Coelce's market is expected to grow at an annual rate of seven percent through 2005, and the company, already in the midst of a deep restructuring effort, has much room for efficiency gains, she added.

-- "As a result of strong energy demand, efficiency gains and cost-cutting, we project robust growth in net income of 8 times in 1996-97 and of 40 percent over the three-year spand 1997-2000," Aldworth said.
-- The analyst said Coelce shares were trading at a 27 percent discount to the sector's average.
-- Credit Lyonnais set a year-end price target of 7.8 reais per 1,000 shares "... implying price upside of for Coelce of 44 percent."
-- Coelce preferred A closed 1.85 percent higher at 5.50 reais Tuesday on the Sao Paulo bourse.
